messages:
alex_ops: heads up ap-northeast2 GPU pool B is failing attaches for ~7m, attach queue jumping. IOPS on local NVMe spiked hard and overlayfs unlink errors showing up. anyone watching? :eyes:
jing_sre: seeing attach_errors and node state io-pend. janitor queue ~11k. can we throttle tempfile sweeper?
omar_eng: we rolled tempfile-sweeper change in last deploy increasing concurrency from 8->32 to speed cleanup. didn't canary in ap-northeast2. that might be the cause.
lena_infra: tail from affected host:
```
[ 4021.001234] nvme nvme0: I/O 0x1f4 timed out, qid 2
[ 4021.001400] overlayfs: unlink failed: -5
[ 4021.502000] writeback_kthread blocked for 7000ms
[ 4022.110000] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 55555555
```
jing_sre: -5 chown/unlink often means underlying I/O errors. ops-bot: what's janitor config and SMART summary?
ops-bot: Janitor ap-northeast2: queue=11234 concurrency=32 rate=0.8/s. SMART: reallocated_sectors_count >80 on 4 nodes, >250 on 1 node. nvme reset events: 9 hosts in last 15m.
alex_ops: mitigation plan: 1) reduce sweeper concurrency to 6 and batch_size=100 2) add exponential jitter on enqueue 3) shift new gpu:batch attaches to reserve-warmpool-apne2 for 15m (canary 8%) 4) cordon worst hosts for fsck and possible drive swaps after drain
omar_eng: applying sweeper throttle now, will queue rollback PR for the concurrency bump. also add soft enqueue caps per-namespace to avoid global floods.
ops-bot: Action: sweeper concurrency set to 6, batch_size=100 by omar_eng at 03:12 UTC. Route update: 8% gpu:batch -> reserve-warmpool-apne2 by alex_ops.
jing_sre: I/O numbers: pre-spike write_iops ~12k -> peak ~140k, latency median 18ms -> 72ms. after throttle, iops down to ~50k and attach retries fell ~35%.
lena_infra: follow-ups: - fsck -n overnight on flagged nodes, prepare drive replacements for nodes with SMART>200 - investigate tempfile-sweeper PR for smallfile pattern inefficiency (PR #5340) - instrument overlayfs unlink/failure histogram
ajex_ops: cost note: 15m of reserve usage estimated ~$900. cheaper than full rollback outage.
omar_eng: assigning owners: @omar_eng rollback PR + instrumentation, @lena_infra schedule drains & hardware swaps, @jing_sre monitor SLOs and set alert attach_latency>500ms.
ops-bot: Incident summary: ap-northeast2 ephemeral tempfile storm -> janitor surge -> NVMe resets -> GPU attach holds. Mitigations applied: sweeper throttle, 8% routing to reserve, cordon plan. Owners: omar_eng, lena_infra.
alex_ops: keeping thread open 2hrs. will page if resets spike again. thanks all :v:
